performance.verdict: Meta efficiency is real; Google $1,039 spend with zero conversions is the crisis.

findings.text: Meta channel_dark flag: $0 meta spend on Aug 22–23 (2 consecutive zero days); 28d CPL $16.99 is healthy but depends entirely on Meta resuming.
Google spent $1,038.67 over 28 days with 0 conversions recorded; top campaign 'BWS - Search Campaign - Calls' consumed $736.30 with no attributed leads.
SOW milestone 'Stripe Products QA'd & Done' (due 2026-07-20) shows no completed-event match; Becklar billing drop and BWS duplicate-check verifications also remain unconfirmed.
3-day signal (Aug 21–23) vs prior 3 (Aug 18–20): leads 8 vs 4, spend $131.74 vs $102.13 — Meta recovery trend is real but fragile given two zero-spend days on Aug 22–23.
GHL shows 136 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments in 28 days; 155 leads arriving with no pipeline conversion suggests an intake or follow-up process gap, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads conversion tracking immediately; $1,038.67 spent with 0 conversions is a confirmed pixel/tracking failure, not a performance failure.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $1,038.67 over 28 days (top campaign 'BWS - Search Campaign - Calls' alone: $736.30) and recorded exactly 0 conversions — this matches the known client-side pixel issue flagged in the data. Audit the Google tag firing on the thank-you/call-completion event this week and confirm events appear in Google Ads Diagnostics. Success check: at least 1 verified conversion event recorded within 7 days of the fix going live. Re-check by 2026-08-31.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta spend resumption: Aug 22–23 were $0 spend days; confirm Meta is live and pacing before any budget changes. Re-check 2026-08-27.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta recorded $0 spend on Aug 22 and Aug 23, triggering the channel_dark flag despite a strong 7d lead surge of +37% and CPL of $16.99. Do not scale budget until at least 3 consecutive days of normal spend ($85–$105/day) are confirmed. Success check: Meta spend back above $80/day for 3 straight days. Re-check by 2026-08-27.

suggestions.text: Escalate GHL intake review: 136 opportunities, 0 won, 0 appointments in 28 days signals a follow-up or pipeline-stage process failure, not an ads issue.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 136 opportunities created against 155 Meta leads but 0 appointments booked and 0 deals won in the 28-day window — this is an intake or automation gap, not an advertising performance problem. Review the lead-to-opportunity workflow and the post-capture follow-up sequence (calls, SMS, or email triggers) to identify where contacts are dropping. Success check: at least 10% of new leads generating a booked appointment within the next 14 days. Re-check by 2026-09-07.
